name: New catalogues preserve the 21 classes, nine rivals, 18 adaptations and 50 pets
Prestige needs a stellar journey and four distinct actual class goals
Prestige retires body and adaptations while preserving pets, eggs, resources, records and looks
Legacy history, trial state and cosmetics round-trip through the same save vault
Both checkpoint failure and retirement-write failure retain the playable old world
Prestige respects the three-slot boundary, rank cap and sandbox isolation
Expedition challenge completion records once without adding power, water or DNA
Custodian trial resets on risk and later ranks require a longer stable hold
Black-hole promise counts only actual accretion at black-hole scale
Cosmetics are achievement/rank gated, stack with no bonuses, and default safely on old saves
Accessory and marking selections persist per slot without polluting another slot
Plaque frame selection uses the existing notice, phases and queue
Actual damaging collisions leave scars; shielded collisions and gentle absorption do not
Scars are bounded, survive evolution/load, and pooled bodies start clean
Five survived impacts earn the new milestone but fatal impacts do not count
Scar, marking and accessory rendering covers every class and detail tier without physics mutation
Inner blueprint requires three actually owned, rocky, safe stable planets
Guardian blueprint measures gas-world distance against both rocky planets
Moon blueprint respects the actual planet/moon hierarchy rather than a summary counter
Belt blueprint needs six real safe objects, and resonance needs an established planetary pair
Blueprint hold resets when disturbed, rewards once and adds no mass/resources/upgrades
Blueprint checkpoints preserve selection and hold; malformed saves are rejected
Every ready species shows its own living hatch; unreached incubation cannot hatch
Hatch skipping, closing, minimizing and repeat claims never reroll or duplicate a pet
Reduced motion reveals a still creature immediately with no additional reveal sounds
New sounds use the same procedural synth, respect mute, and legendary cue plays once
Only F opens the dock; hover, focus and close-button activation cannot open it
Dock inactivity hides even with focus; interaction refreshes time and opening a window hides it
F dock and Escape work with the HUD hidden without stealing propulsion or system Tab
New menu labels, selectable blueprints, cosmetic controls and expedition confirmations are complete
Repeated hatch and prestige/restart operations add no loops, listeners, pooled bodies or animation state
Three naturally captured planets complete an inner blueprint through the production fixed step
Blueprint checks run at five Hz and revalidate the exact arrangement before awarding completion
